prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical fisheye Y2K street-fashion close portrait of an adult Japanese gyaru-inspired model in a dark Tokyo-inspired street or subway setting. She has platinum-blonde hair with dark roots, heavy eye makeup, light lipstick, and long decorated nails. Dress her in a faux-fur vest over a distressed black denim top, with a gold cross pendant and leopard-print choker. Frame both hands in the foreground forming a heart around her face as she looks directly through it at the camera. Use harsh high-contrast direct flash, saturated ambient urban color, subtle bokeh, gritty texture, and controlled fisheye distortion. Keep signage abstract and unreadable. No text, logo, watermark, or sexualized framing.
